upgrades.descriptionEn: The DMLR automatically switches between DMR and laser modes at the given interval, and the laser has infinite charge. Dealing damage with the DMR increases laser damage and dealing damage with the laser increases DMR damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: DMLR 會依指定間隔自動切換 DMR 與雷射模式，且雷射具有無限能量。以 DMR 造成傷害會提高雷射傷害；以雷射造成傷害則會提高 DMR 傷害。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 摧毀核心時，引發元素爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs create a running wave of acid when they impact a surface.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團撞擊表面時，會形成向前奔流的酸液波。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold RELOAD to consume grenade charge. Greatly increases the explosion size of your next glob. This size is increased with your globblometer.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 RELOAD 消耗手榴彈能量，大幅擴大下一顆黏團的爆炸範圍。Globblometer 越高，範圍越大。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taken damage builds up a meter that increases the damage of your globs. Firing a glob consumes less of the meter when your globblometer is higher.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害會累積計量，提高黏團傷害。Globblometer 越高，發射黏團時消耗的計量越少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold the trigger to charge up your glob, increasing its explosion size. Globbing up all ammo causes it to explode on you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住扳機為黏團蓄能，擴大其爆炸範圍。將全部彈藥凝聚為黏團時，它會在你身上爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a different stat boost for each upgrade of a different rarity that touches this one.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每有一個不同稀有度的配件與此配件接觸，就獲得一種不同的能力加成。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs are less powerful but leave behind acid puddles.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團威力降低，但會留下酸液池。

upgrades.descriptionEn: The Globbler reloads over time while unequipped. The globblometer increases your pocket reload speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 未手持 Globbler 時，它會隨時間自動裝填。Globblometer 會提高收起時的裝填速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While holding the Globbler, the globblometer increases your move speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Globbler 時，Globblometer 會提高你的移動速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire three globs in a triangle. Fire rate and explosion size are decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以三角形排列發射三顆黏團。射速降低，爆炸範圍縮小。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs have a chance to be infused with a different element. Infused globs fully apply their element to targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團有機率灌注不同元素。灌注黏團會對目標完整施加該元素效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globblometer is increased, but fire rate is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Globblometer 提高，但射速降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Glob waves created by Flood have an increased length.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 「洪流」產生的黏團波長度增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire globs faster and with more force. Damage and explosion size are decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更高速度和力量發射黏團。傷害降低，爆炸範圍縮小。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your first shot after switching to the Globbler deals increased damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 切換至 Globbler 後，第一發傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reload speed is decreased. But Globblometer is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度降低，但 Globblometer 提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire globs with more force. Recoil is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更大力量發射黏團。後座力增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs deal more damage but fall faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團傷害提高，但下墜更快。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased by your Globblometer.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Globblometer 會提高彈匣容量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs detonate when hitting a surface.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團撞擊表面時引爆。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damaging yourself with a glob provides damage resistance for a short time. The globblometer lengthens this effect.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被自己的黏團傷害時，短時間內獲得傷害抗性。Globblometer 會延長此效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire only one glob with an increased explosion radius. Reload speed is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 只發射一顆爆炸半徑更大的黏團。裝填速度降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globs are fired with a random size. Max size is increased with the Globblometer.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射的黏團大小隨機。Globblometer 會提高最大尺寸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Globblin
upgrades.descriptionZh: Globblin（原文僅有此字）

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥減少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量減少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You deflect incoming projectiles and gain damage resistance while sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用電鋸時，會偏轉飛來的投射物，並獲得傷害抗性。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target has a chance to drop a chunk of health.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，有機率掉落生命碎塊。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain stacks of rage by killing targets. Rage increases your move speed and damage as long as you keep sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標可獲得狂怒層數。只要持續使用電鋸，狂怒就會提高移動速度與傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pull nearby grunts toward you while sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用電鋸時，將附近的普通兵吸向自己。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deflector size and damage resistance are increased, but you move slower while sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 偏轉器範圍與傷害抗性提高，但使用電鋸時移動更慢。

upgrades.descriptionEn: When you kill a target, you have an increased chance to fire a shocking lightning bolt for each stack of blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，每一層鮮血都會提高發射電擊閃電的機率。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your jump height is increased for each stack of blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每一層鮮血都會提高跳躍高度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core generates a small amount of reserve ammo for your equipped heavy weapon. This upgrade can stack
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺核心時，為目前手持的重型武器產生少量備用彈藥。此配件效果可疊加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Applies fire. Potency increases the longer the saw is active.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加火焰效果。電鋸啟動越久，效果越強。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While firing, you periodically emit a burst that heals other nearby players.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 開火時，定期釋放脈衝，治療附近的其他玩家。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nutritious cores also creates health chunk for allies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 營養核心也會為隊友產生生命碎塊。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sawing speed is increased for a short time after you are electrocuted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電後，短時間內電鋸運轉速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Upon reaching the given threshold, all stacks of blood are consumed and your movement ability is partially recharged.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 達到指定門檻時，消耗全部鮮血層數，並為移動技能補充部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Saw in a much smaller area. Damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 電鋸傷害範圍大幅縮小，傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage resistance is increased for each stack of blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每一層鮮血都會提高傷害抗性。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased for each stack of blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每一層鮮血都會提高傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased for a short time after you are corroded.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到腐蝕後，短時間內射程增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size and ammo capacity are increased but you regenerate less ammo from dealing damage with your other weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量與彈藥攜帶量增加，但用其他武器造成傷害時，恢復的彈藥減少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo is refunded to your magazine when you are ignited.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃時，為彈匣返還彈藥。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While firing, you move faster but take more damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 開火時移動更快，但受到的傷害增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but you take more damage while sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但使用電鋸時受到的傷害增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage area is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害範圍擴大。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can hold more stacks of blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 可持有更多鮮血層數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing targets provides more blood.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時獲得更多鮮血。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold RELOAD to charge up the Shocklance and release to launch yourself forward. Any targets in your way are drilled for continuous damage. Multiple Auger Subroutines increase damage and launch duration.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 RELOAD 為 Shocklance 蓄能，放開後將自己向前發射。路徑上的所有目標都會受到鑽擊的持續傷害。安裝多個 Auger Subroutine 可提高傷害與發射持續時間。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Consecutive shots are fired full-auto without needing to charge up.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 後續射擊改為全自動連射，無須重新蓄能。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Press INTERACT to tether yourself to another employee. While tethered, you gain damage resistance and deal increased damage. The other employee's movement ability recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按 INTERACT 與另一位員工建立連結。連結期間，你獲得傷害抗性並造成更高傷害；另一位員工的移動技能充能更快。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target has a chance to create an elemental explosion. Targets killed by the explosion have a chance to create another explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，有機率引發元素爆炸。被爆炸擊殺的目標也有機率引發另一次爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage and charge-up time are greatly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害與蓄能時間大幅增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage increases with each shot fired before reloading. Multiple copies of this upgrade can stack, but with diminishing returns.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填前每射出一發，傷害就會提高。此配件可安裝多個並疊加效果，但效益會逐漸遞減。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is greatly increased, but so is recoil.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程大幅增加，但後座力也大幅增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Applies decay.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加衰敗效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While Auger Subroutine is active and for a short time after, the Shocklance charges faster and you gain damage resistance.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Auger Subroutine 啟動期間及結束後短時間內，Shocklance 蓄能加快，且你獲得傷害抗性。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Coils linger and increase your outgoing damage when inside.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 線圈會持續存在；身處其中時，你造成的傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: The Shocklance passively charges over time. Passive charges is slowed when unequipped.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Shocklance 會隨時間被動蓄能。未手持時，被動蓄能速度降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: After firing your last shot, an additional coil is fired upward with increased size and damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射出最後一發後，額外向上發射一個尺寸與傷害提高的線圈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Coils linger and increase the move speed of any player inside.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 線圈會持續存在，並提高其中所有玩家的移動速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You gain increased turning speed while Auger Subroutine is active.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Auger Subroutine 啟動期間，轉向速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Size is increased but range is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 尺寸增加，但射程縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing melee damage briefly increases the Shocklance's damage and refunds some reserve ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 造成近戰傷害後，Shocklance 傷害短暫提高，並返還部分備用彈藥。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Charge speed is increased, but magazine size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 蓄能速度提高，但彈匣容量減少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while charging the Shocklance.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 為 Shocklance 蓄能時，移動速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Applies fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加火焰效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Charge duration is increased but you can fire at any time while charging. Damage, size, and range are increased the longer you charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 蓄能時間增加，但蓄能期間可隨時開火。蓄能越久，傷害、尺寸與射程越高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Greatly reduces vertical recoil when Splintered Lance is equipped.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝備 Splintered Lance 時，大幅降低垂直後座力。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire in a tight line. Range and damage are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以緊密直線射擊。射程與傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Base damage is decreased but the damage of your shots increases for each target they pierce.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 基礎傷害降低，但射擊每穿透一個目標，傷害就會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire multiple shots with little accuracy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以較低準確度發射多發。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Piercing multiple targets builds up extra damage for your next shot.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 穿透多個目標可為下一次射擊累積額外傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but so is charge-up time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但蓄能時間也增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Coils apply more of their element to targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 線圈會對目標施加更多所屬元素。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to consume your grenade and convert the rest of your magazine into explosive bullets of that grenade's element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗手榴彈，將彈匣剩餘彈藥轉為與該手榴彈同元素的爆炸彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: On reload, you warp back in time to a previous position, then gain a small speed boost and create an explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時回溯至先前的位置，隨後獲得小幅速度提升並產生爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Upon taking damage, you have a chance to fire out a tracking missile.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害時，有機率發射追蹤飛彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Each stack of the Accelerator's element you apply to targets to before reloading increases the chance to refund your last burst. Some stacks are consumed upon refund.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填前，每對目標施加一層 Accelerator 所屬元素，都會提高返還最後一輪點放彈藥的機率。返還時會消耗部分層數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage increases based on how fast you're moving. Base damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 移動越快，傷害越高。基礎傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a tracking missile at the end of each burst. The missile's damage and explosion size increase with burst size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每輪點放結束時發射一枚追蹤飛彈。每輪發射的子彈越多，飛彈傷害與爆炸範圍越大。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your magazine is refilled when you are electrocuted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電時，彈匣補滿。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While you are swarmed by bees, the Accelerator deals increased damage. you move faster, and you fall slower.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被蜂群包圍時，Accelerator 傷害提高、移動更快，且下墜更慢。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire one massive burst.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 一次進行超大量點放射擊。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create a healing swarm of bees when you reload. After a short duration, the bees begin to damage you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時產生治療蜂群。短時間後，蜜蜂開始對你造成傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While holding the Accelerator, you regenerate health more quickly the faster you're moving. Regen speed is further increased when the Accelerator's element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Accelerator 時，移動越快，生命恢復越快。自身完整承受 Accelerator 所屬元素效果時，恢復速度會進一步提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire 3 pellets per shot with less accuracy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次射擊發射 3 顆彈丸，準確度降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Unstable recursion leading to unstable recursion leading to unstable recursion leading to
upgrades.descriptionZh: 不穩定遞迴導致不穩定遞迴導致不穩定遞迴導致

upgrades.descriptionEn: Appleid bees.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加蜜蜂效果。（原文：Appleid bees.）

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create a bee explosion when you reload that damages you and nearby enemies. Explosion size and amount of bees increase for each burst fired before reloading.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時產生蜜蜂爆炸，傷害自己與附近敵人。裝填前點放的次數越多，爆炸範圍與蜜蜂數量越多。

upgrades.descriptionEn: After firing a burst, gain a burst of speed for each bullet fired.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 完成一輪點放後，每射出一發子彈就獲得一次短促加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Enables full-auto firing. Burst interval is slightly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟用全自動射擊。點放間隔略微增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target grants a stacking bonus to fire rate and reload speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，獲得可疊加的射速與裝填速度加成。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Shoot allies with bee bullets to heal them.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以蜜蜂子彈射擊隊友可治療他們。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Direct hits deal increased damage while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時，直接命中造成的傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Every burst fires 5 bullets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每輪點放發射 5 發子彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets have a small chance to explode on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈有小幅機率在命中時爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a burst of speed when reloading with an empty magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣清空後裝填時，獲得一次短促加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Generate ammo over time while sprinting. If bees are applied to your bullets, your ammo regenerates faster while airborne.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時隨時間產生彈藥。子彈帶有蜜蜂效果時，滯空期間彈藥恢復更快。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target grants a stacking move speed bonus.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，獲得可疊加的移動速度加成。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullet size is increased while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時，子彈尺寸增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reload speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal more damage but apply less shock.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但施加的電擊減少。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply more of the elemental effect.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加的元素效果增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Let's trade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 來交換吧。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Attempting to use your Rocket Lasso while it's recharging damages you and grants some charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索充能期間嘗試使用它，會傷害自己並獲得部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You periodically mark a nearby medium or large enemy for death, gaining increased damage against it. Killing a marked enemy moves the mark to another nearby enemy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 定期將附近一名中型或大型敵人標記為死亡目標，提高你對它的傷害。擊殺標記敵人後，標記會轉移至附近另一名敵人。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Air Dash charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Eyes have a chance to sprout from enemies you kill. Destroy an eye to gain health and a stacking bonus to damage and move speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺的敵人有機率長出眼睛。摧毀眼睛可恢復生命，並獲得可疊加的傷害與移動速度加成。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee a surface below you to launch yourself upward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 近戰攻擊下方表面，可將自己向上彈射。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Handspring creates a small explosion.
Explosion Size: [2.8 - 3.02]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
Handspring 會產生小型爆炸。
爆炸範圍：[2.8 - 3.02]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Air Dash ignites targets in your wake.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺會點燃身後路徑上的目標。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Changes Element to [Shock - Acid].
Recharge Speed: [-24.81% - -35.48%]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Briefly gain immunity after using your air dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用空中衝刺後，短暫獲得無敵效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Rocket Lasso charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your lasso explodes.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 套索會爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Push nearby targets in the direction of your air dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 將附近目標朝空中衝刺的方向推開。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is briefly increased after using your Air Dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用空中衝刺後，滑行速度短暫提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: When landing with enough force. some of your vertical momentum is converted to horizontal speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以足夠力道落地時，部分垂直動量會轉為水平速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Using a quip gives you a burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用俏皮話時，獲得一次短促加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Creates an explosion at your current position when you use your Rocket Lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用火箭套索時，在目前位置產生爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Rocket Lasso has a chance to partially recharge when you fully apply the given element to a target.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對目標完整施加指定元素效果時，有機率為火箭套索補充部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Recharges your Air Dash when the given element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 自身完整承受指定元素效果時，為空中衝刺充能。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain increased fire rate and reload speed when under full health.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命未滿時，射速與裝填速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your equipped weapon is partially reloaded when you throw your lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拋出套索時，為目前手持的武器裝填部分彈藥。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lassoing a broken player part refunds some Rocket Lasso charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住玩家破損的零件時，返還部分火箭套索能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump out of a slide to gain a burst of upward speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行中起跳，獲得一次向上加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso range is increased for each cell that touches this upgrade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每有一格與此配件接觸，火箭套索射程就會增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pulling a health chunk with your lasso equips it. Throw the chunk to create a healing explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索拉回生命碎塊時，會將它拿在手上。投擲碎塊可產生治療爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lasso a Hornet to push it away.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住胡蜂可將它推開。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lasso a surface directly in front of you to launch yourself away from it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住正前方表面，可將自己朝反方向彈射。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is briefly increased after using your Rocket Lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用火箭套索後，滑行速度短暫提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your melee damage and size is increased for a short time after using your Rocket Lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用火箭套索後，短時間內近戰傷害與範圍提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump out of a slide to gain a burst of forward speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行中起跳，獲得一次向前加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Air Dash now sends you in whatever direction you are facing, without restrictions.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺可不受限制地朝任何面向方向移動。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can aim while sliding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時可以瞄準。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide when landing to roll and gain a burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 落地時滑行，可翻滾並獲得一次短促加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Air Dash duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺持續時間增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso range and force are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索射程與力量提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing damage extends your slide and increases reload speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 造成傷害可延長滑行時間，並提高裝填速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso force is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索力量提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Made of harder hard-light.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 由更硬的硬光製成。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide in the air to cannonball downwards at great speeds. Hitting the ground with enough force triggers a special Nose Dive impact that deals increased damage but has less potent effects.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中滑行，可像砲彈般高速向下墜落。以足夠力道撞地時，會觸發特殊的俯衝撞擊，傷害更高，但附加效果較弱。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Nose Dive charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector creates a large cube that traps enemies inside. Players inside the cute heal over time. Shield duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器改為產生大型立方體，將敵人困在其中。立方體內的玩家會持續恢復生命。護盾持續時間增加。（原文 cute 疑為 cube 誤植）
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Players inside your prison deal increased damage.
Damage: [+23% - +26%]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
監牢內的玩家造成的傷害提高。
傷害：[+23% - +26%]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Nose Dive impact creates a temporary bubble shield.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊落地時，產生暫時的泡泡護盾。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive releases a bolt of lightning that arcs between up to 12 targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊釋放閃電，最多在 12 個目標之間跳躍。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold F to gain damage resistance and draw the attention of all enemies for a short time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 F，在短時間內獲得傷害抗性並吸引所有敵人的注意。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Optical Attraction heals you and nearby employees.
Healing: [+7 - +8]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
Optical Attraction 可治療你與附近員工。
治療量：[+7 - +8]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive's blast radius increases based on how far you dove.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝距離越遠，俯衝撞擊的爆炸半徑越大。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector is now a dome.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器改為圓頂形。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector applies the given element to targets within its impact zone. Cooldown is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器會對落點區域內的目標施加指定元素。冷卻時間增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bounce from Nose Dive into another dive.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊後可彈起，再次俯衝。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Landing a Nose Dive briefly empowers your next shield, increasing its damage and reducing its duration. This shield refunds some charge when it runs out.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊落地後，短時間內施放的下一面護盾獲得強化，傷害提高但持續時間縮短。這面護盾結束時會返還部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive applies whatever element you're currently affected by.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊會施加你目前承受的元素效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive applies decay.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊施加衰敗效果。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector grants all nearby players an overshield when placed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 放置護盾投射器時，為附近所有玩家提供額外護盾。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Activating your Shield Projector launches you backward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟動護盾投射器時，將你向後彈射。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hit allies with your Nose Dive to reload their weapons.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊命中隊友時，為他們的武器裝填。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health is increased, but run speed is slightly decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命提高，但奔跑速度略微降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Press P 3 times to detonate yourself.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按 P 3 次即可自爆。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive deals much more damage in a much smaller radius.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊的傷害大幅提高，但作用半徑大幅縮小。

upgrades.descriptionEn: More Nose Dive charge is refunded when you leap without diving.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 跳起後未進行俯衝時，返還更多俯衝撞擊能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Shield Projector cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: All other players are healed when you die.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 死亡時治療所有其他玩家。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your leap travels much further.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 躍起時的移動距離大幅增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive pulls targets toward you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊會將目標拉向你。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Allies hit by your Nose Dive become briefly immune.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被俯衝撞擊命中的隊友短暫無敵。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Making an ally immune with With Me makes you briefly immune.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 透過 With Me 讓隊友無敵時，你也會短暫無敵。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump during a Nose Dive to cancel it and keep your momentum.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊期間按跳躍，可取消俯衝並保留動量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector pushes enemies away with more force.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器以更大的力量推開敵人。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive blast radius is increased, but damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊爆炸半徑增加，但傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Leap with more force when activating Nose Dive.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟動俯衝撞擊時，起跳力量提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive pushes targets away from you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊會將目標推離你。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Shield Projector cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Feeling a little lightheaded?
upgrades.descriptionZh: 是不是有點頭昏？

upgrades.descriptionEn: The first time you melee while attached to your Grapple Pole, you throw out a beehive that causes a bee explosion on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 連接抓鉤柱期間，第一次近戰攻擊會拋出蜂巢，撞擊時引發蜜蜂爆炸。
upgrades.turbochargeEn: Additional melee attacks throw out smaller beehives.
upgrades.turbochargeZh: 後續近戰攻擊會丟出較小的蜂巢。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an elemental explosion when you collect a large health chunk. Collecting smaller health chunks provides a stacking damage boost. Enemy cores always drop at least 1 health chunk.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拾取大型生命碎塊時，產生元素爆炸。拾取較小的生命碎塊時，獲得可堆疊的傷害加成。敵人核心必定掉落至少 1 個生命碎塊。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Converts your Grapple Pole into a hovering eyeball. Press PING to redirect the eyeball to a new position.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 將抓鉤柱轉換為懸浮眼球。按下 PING，將眼球重新導向新位置。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Grapple Range: [+7 - +8.6]
Grapple Time: [+14% - +23%]
Recharge Speed: [-16.67% - -18.7%]

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can place up to two Grapple Poles at once.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 最多可同時放置兩根抓鉤柱。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Grappling recharges your other placed poles over time.
Recharge Speed: [+0.4]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
使用鉤索時，會隨時間為其他已放置的立柱充能。
充能速度：[+0.4]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Attach your Grapple Pole to a player to turn them into a grapple node.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 可將抓鉤柱附著在玩家身上，使其成為抓鉤節點。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Player nodes can be grappled from further away.
Grapple Range: [+19 - +24]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
可從更遠處鉤住玩家節點。
鉤索射程：[+19 - +24]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack creates a large plume of fire that ignites any targets below you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包會產生大股火焰，點燃下方的所有目標。
upgrades.turbochargeEn:
Igniting a target with your jetpack refunds some fuel.
Fuel Refunded: [+0.1 - +0.12]
upgrades.turbochargeZh:
以噴射背包點燃目標時，返還部分燃料。
返還燃料：[+0.1 - +0.12]

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an elemental explosion at your position the first time you use your Grapple Pole.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 第一次使用抓鉤柱時，在你的位置產生元素爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Use less grapple pole energy while the chosen element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素完全施加於你時，抓鉤柱的能量消耗降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You move faster for each stack of scrap you have. Scrap decays faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每層廢料都會提高移動速度。廢料消退得更快。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While using your Grapple Pole, your Jetpack recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用抓鉤柱期間，噴射背包的充能速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: The first time your Grapple Pole runs out of energy, its energy is partially recharged and the given element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤柱第一次耗盡能量時，恢復部分能量，並將指定元素完全施加於你。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple duration is increased for each unique upgrade that touches this one.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每個與此配件接觸的不同升級配件，都會延長抓鉤持續時間。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Grapple Pole emits an antigravity field.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤柱會釋放反重力場。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Consume scrap to continue using your jetpack after its fuel has been depleted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的燃料耗盡後，可消耗廢料繼續使用。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold your grenade key to barf up a damaging stream of spare parts.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住手榴彈按鍵，吐出一股能造成傷害的備用零件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Grapple Pole creates a health chunk when placed, and creates more small chunks while grappling. Depleting a pole's enemy creates a bunch of health chunks.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤柱放置時會產生一個生命碎塊，使用抓鉤期間會持續產生更多小型碎塊。耗盡柱子的敵人會產生一大堆生命碎塊。（原文此處為 enemy，語意待核對。）

upgrades.descriptionEn: Swing into enemies to damage them.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擺盪撞向敵人可造成傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack pushes you forward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包會將你向前推進。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Release your fuel much faster in a stronger burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更快的速度釋放燃料，產生更強的瞬間加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump force is greatly increased when crouching.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 蹲下時，跳躍力量大幅提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee an explosive part to instantly start its fuse and increase its explosion size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊命中爆炸零件，立即啟動其引信，並擴大爆炸範圍。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Grapple Pole is partially recharged when the given element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素完全施加於你時，抓鉤柱恢復部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple duration is greatly increased when out of combat. This applies to any player who uses your grapple pole.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 非戰鬥狀態下，抓鉤持續時間大幅延長。所有使用你抓鉤柱的玩家皆適用。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Players gain a burst of speed when detaching from your Grapple Pole.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 玩家脫離你的抓鉤柱時，獲得瞬間加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Use less grapple pole energy while using your grapple pole at the same time as another player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 與其他玩家同時使用你的抓鉤柱時，抓鉤柱的能量消耗降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack lasts longer but is less stable.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的持續時間延長，但穩定性降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple Pole cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤柱的冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Players heal over time while attached to your Grapple Pole.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 玩家連接你的抓鉤柱期間，會持續恢復生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的充能速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jetpack duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jetpack force is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的推力提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grapple range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤範圍增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your wingsuit no longer recharges over time. Dealing damage provides some charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 翼裝不再隨時間充能。造成傷害可獲得部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target while mid-air grants some wingsuit charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中擊殺目標時，獲得部分翼裝能量。
upgrades.turbochargeEn: You fall slower for a moment after flying.
upgrades.turbochargeZh: 飛行結束後，短暫降低下墜速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While airborne, your Rocket Salvo is replaced with a decay bomb.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空期間，火箭齊射會被替換成衰敗炸彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rockets ricochet to nearby targets multiple times. Rocket damage decreases with each bounce.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭可多次彈射至附近目標。每次彈射後，火箭傷害都會降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo fires a massive barrage of rockets. Cooldown is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射會發射大規模火箭彈幕。冷卻時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold Q to create a cloud of Saxonite where you're looking that immobilizes enemies and makes grunts float.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 Q，在視線位置產生 Saxonite 雲霧，使敵人無法移動，並使基礎敵兵浮起。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Double tap LEFT or RIGHT while flying to dodge in either direction.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行時連按兩次 LEFT 或 RIGHT，即可朝對應方向閃避。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee size and damage are greatly increased for a short time after flying for at least 0.5 seconds.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行至少 0.5 秒後，近戰攻擊範圍與傷害會在短時間內大幅提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your wingsuit is partially recharged the first time you pick up a broken player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 第一次抱起損壞的玩家時，翼裝恢復部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Small health chunks orbit you and wait to popup until you've taken enough damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 小型生命碎塊會環繞你，直到你受到足夠傷害後才彈出。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing your Rocket Salvo while flying refunds some wingsuit charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行時施放火箭齊射，可返還部分翼裝能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo recharges much faster, but costs health to fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射的充能速度大幅提高，但發射會消耗生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide out of a glide to gain a large burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從滑翔轉為滑行時，獲得大幅瞬間加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Rocket Salvo is partially recharged when you heal a target with it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用火箭齊射治療目標時，火箭齊射會恢復部分能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo fires only one rocket at a time and recharges faster. Gain an extra salvo charge for each rocket.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射每次只發射一枚火箭，充能速度提高。每枚火箭都會提供一次額外的齊射使用次數。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Use ammo reserves from your equipped weapon to lock onto extra targets with your Rocket Salvo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 消耗目前裝備武器的備用彈藥，讓火箭齊射鎖定額外目標。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Wingsuit fly duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 翼裝飛行持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: When you run out of fuel, your wingsuit is partially recharged and you are ignited. This won't trigger again until your wingsuit has charged a little on its own.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 燃料耗盡時，翼裝會恢復部分能量，並將你點燃。翼裝自行恢復少量能量前，此效果不會再次觸發。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while holding a broken player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抱著損壞的玩家時，移動速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Heal yourself when you fire a salvo rocket at an ally.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 向友軍發射齊射火箭時，恢復自身生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Salvo rockets apply the given element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 齊射火箭會施加指定元素。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain health when you pick up a broken player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 抱起損壞的玩家時，恢復生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You deal more damage while airborne.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空時，造成的傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You fall slower while aiming your Rocket Salvo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準火箭齊射時，下落速度降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can change direction while flying.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行期間可以改變方向。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Speed is increased when flying backward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 向後飛行時，速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo fires an extra healing rocket that tracks to a nearby player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射會額外發射一枚治療火箭，自動追蹤附近玩家。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Salvo rockets deal increased damage but no longer explode.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 齊射火箭的傷害提高，但不再爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire more rockets that deal reduced damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射更多火箭，但每枚火箭的傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fly speed is increased, but so is your Rocket Salvo's cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行速度提高，但火箭齊射的冷卻時間也會延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire an extra rocket. Rocket Salvo damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 額外發射一枚火箭。火箭齊射的傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Wingsuit fly duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 翼裝飛行持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo healing is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射的治療量提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射的冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fly speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades cost health to fire and no longer have a cooldown
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投擲手榴彈會消耗生命值，且不再有冷卻時間。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade explodes into clusters of more grenades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸時會分裂出成群的額外手榴彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sliding will periodically throw out your grenade without consuming a charge. Stacking this upgrade throws additional grenades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時，會定期拋出不消耗使用次數的手榴彈。疊加此升級配件可拋出額外的手榴彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster when standing near your last grenade's explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站在上一枚手榴彈的爆炸位置附近時，手榴彈的充能速度提高。

upgrades.nameEn: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade has a small chance to toss out a grenade. This chance is proportional to the amount of damage taken.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，有小機率拋出一枚手榴彈。此機率與受到的傷害量成正比。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking fire damage grants stacks of combustion. At 100 stacks you create a fiery explosion, igniting nearby enemies and healing yourself.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到火焰傷害時，獲得燃燒層數。達到 100 層時，產生火焰爆炸，點燃附近敵人並治療自己。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throwing your grenade has a chance to instantly recharge it, but also has a chance to instantly kill you. Both chances increase on each successful recharge and reset when the grenade kills you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投擲手榴彈時，有機率立即恢復充能，也有機率使你立即死亡。每次成功恢復充能，兩種機率都會提高；被手榴彈殺死時重置。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While ignited, you take more damage over time but also deal more damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃期間，承受的持續傷害提高，但造成的傷害也會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain grenade charge when you are ignited.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃時，獲得手榴彈能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hitting an ignited target with your melee generates grenade charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊命中被點燃的目標時，獲得手榴彈能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade provides some grenade charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，獲得部分手榴彈能量。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damaging yourself with a grenade grants wildfire. While wildfire is active, any normal damage you deal is converted to fire damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以手榴彈傷害自己時，獲得野火效果。野火生效期間，你造成的所有一般傷害都會轉換為火焰傷害。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second grenade charge. Cooldown is slightly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 獲得第二次手榴彈使用次數。冷卻時間略微延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hitting a corroded target with your grenade increases the explosion size of your next grenade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以手榴彈命中被腐蝕的目標時，下一枚手榴彈的爆炸範圍增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenade cooldown is reduced, but you take more fire damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的冷卻時間縮短，但受到的火焰傷害提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenades deal more impact damage but deal extra damage to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的撞擊傷害提高，但對你造成的傷害也會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your melee applies fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 近戰攻擊會施加火焰。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Any outgoing damage matching this grenade's element is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 你造成的傷害若與此手榴彈的元素相同，傷害會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain health when you throw a grenade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投擲手榴彈時，恢復生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades bounce and explode on each bounce.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會彈跳，且每次彈跳都會爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade explosions heal players.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸會治療玩家。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade applies less of its element to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈對你施加的元素量減少。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的冷卻時間縮短。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的傷害大幅降低，爆炸半徑變得很小，但充能速度大幅提高。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 你會化身手榴彈，多次爆炸並提高移動速度。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 獲得一次幅度較小的二段跳。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會受磁力吸引而飛向敵人。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命值危急時，投擲手榴彈可恢復部分移動技能能量。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸若命中被點燃的目標，會產生第二次傷害爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade provides some grenade charge.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈命中你時，會將你垂直向上彈飛。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會將你向爆炸中心以外的方向彈飛。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Any outgoing damage matching this grenade's element is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 你造成的傷害若與此手榴彈的元素相同，傷害會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while your grenade is recharging.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈充能期間，移動速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenades phase through shields.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會穿過護盾。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster while sliding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行期間，手榴彈的充能速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades stun enemies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會使敵人暈眩。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Players hit by the grenade's explosion gain increased move speed for a short time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被手榴彈爆炸命中的玩家，會在短時間內提高移動速度。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade is partially recharged when you get hit by an enemy's overclocked explosion. You gain more charge the closer you are to the explosion's epicenter. Overclocked explosions that would kill you instead reduce your health to 1.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被敵人的超頻爆炸命中時，手榴彈會恢復部分能量。越靠近爆炸中心，獲得的能量越多。足以致命的超頻爆炸會改為將你的生命值降至 1。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You have a chance to create an acid explosion when you take damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害時，有機率產生酸液爆炸。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades apply rot to metallic targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會對金屬目標施加腐朽。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 以手榴彈命中觸電目標時，會將其點燃。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸後，會留下持續存在的酸液池。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Teleport to your grenade when it lands.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈落地時，傳送到其位置。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster while you are standing still.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站立不動時，手榴彈的充能速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades pull targets in before exploding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸前，會將目標拉向自身。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster while standing in an acid puddle.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站在酸液池中時，手榴彈的充能速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throw 2 grenades at once in a larger spread. Explosion size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更大的散布範圍同時投擲 2 枚手榴彈。爆炸範圍縮小。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Players hit by your grenade's explosion gain movement ability charge. Cooldown is slightly reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被手榴彈爆炸命中的玩家，會獲得移動技能能量。冷卻時間略微縮短。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈有機率產生第二次爆炸，元素隨機。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈撞擊時，會給予附近玩家額外護盾。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的投擲力量提高，且不受重力影響。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 將所有造成的傷害轉換為指定元素。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 最大生命值額外提高 50%。取得此升級配件時，會重抽所有現有升級配件，但不改變其形狀。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 收起的武器會在短時間後自動裝填。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 拾取生命碎塊時，獲得小幅瞬間加速。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You take more damage but also receive more healing from health chunks.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到的傷害提高，但從生命碎塊獲得的治療量也會提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain health when you stop taking damage from the given elemental effect.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 停止受到指定元素效果的傷害時，恢復生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Apply more fire to all targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對所有目標施加的火焰量增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing an enemy with a melee attack drops additional small health chunks.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊擊殺敵人時，會額外掉落小型生命碎塊。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命值提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain health when you repair another player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 修復其他玩家時，恢復自身生命值。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Apply more shock to all targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對所有目標施加的電擊量增加。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slider duration is increased for each cell that touches another upgrade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每個與其他升級配件接觸的格位，都會延長滑行持續時間。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while electrocuted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電期間，移動速度提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take less acid damage from being corroded.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被腐蝕時，受到的酸液傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take less fire damage from being ignited.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃時，受到的火焰傷害降低。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take less shock damage from being electrocuted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電時，受到的電擊傷害降低。
